# The University of Aberdeen

> The University of Aberdeen is a leading Scottish research institution offering undergraduate, postgraduate taught, postgraduate research, and online degree programs with strong rankings and global scholarship opportunities.

Aberdeen is a prestigious UK university providing comprehensive study options across 400+ degree programmes, flexible learning formats (full-time, part-time, online), and extensive research opportunities. The university serves students globally with support services, funding options, and international exchange programs.

## Key Topics

- Undergraduate Programs
- Postgraduate Taught Degrees
- PhD and Postgraduate Research
- Online Learning
- Master's Degrees (MSc, PgCert, PgDip)
- Part-time Study
- Subject Areas
- Scholarships and Funding
- UCAS
- Research Areas
- Student Support
- Distance Education
- Study Abroad
- Admissions
- Aberdeen Global Scholarship

## Undergraduate Study

- [Undergraduate Study Portal](https://www.abdn.ac.uk/study/undergraduate): Main undergraduate entry point with 2026 entry information and degree options.
- [Undergraduate Degree Programmes](https://www.abdn.ac.uk/study/undergraduate/degree-programmes): Searchable directory of 400+ undergraduate degree programmes with UCAS codes.
- [Undergraduate Subject Areas](https://www.abdn.ac.uk/study/undergraduate/subject-areas): Browse undergraduate subject areas from Accountancy to Zoology with rankings.
- [Study Abroad Opportunities](https://www.abdn.ac.uk/study/undergraduate/go-abroad): International exchange and study abroad opportunities for undergraduate students.

## Postgraduate Taught Programmes

- [Postgraduate Taught Study Portal](https://www.abdn.ac.uk/study/postgraduate-taught): Postgraduate taught degrees with flexible full-time, part-time, and online options.
- [Postgraduate Taught Degree Programmes](https://www.abdn.ac.uk/study/postgraduate-taught/degree-programmes): Master's degrees (MSc, PgCert, PgDip) with flexible study delivery options.
- [Part-time Postgraduate Study](https://www.abdn.ac.uk/study/postgraduate-taught/part-time): Part-time postgraduate qualifications designed for working professionals.
- [Postgraduate Taught Finance and Funding](https://www.abdn.ac.uk/study/postgraduate-taught/finance): Tuition fees, scholarships, and financial aid for postgraduate taught students.
- [Postgraduate Taught Application Guide](https://www.abdn.ac.uk/study/postgraduate-taught/how-to-apply): Application guidance and portal links for postgraduate taught programmes.

## Postgraduate Research and PhDs

- [Postgraduate Research Study Portal](https://www.abdn.ac.uk/study/postgraduate-research): PhD and postgraduate research opportunities with doctoral training support.
- [Research Areas](https://www.abdn.ac.uk/study/postgraduate-research/research-areas): Research areas directory spanning Accountancy, Anthropology, Health Sciences and more.
- [Available PhD Opportunities](https://www.abdn.ac.uk/study/postgraduate-research/phds): Available PhD projects and opportunities searchable via FindaPhD.com.
- [PhD Finance and Funding](https://www.abdn.ac.uk/study/postgraduate-research/finance): PhD funding, scholarships, and financial information for research students.
- [PhD Application Guide](https://www.abdn.ac.uk/study/postgraduate-research/apply): PhD application requirements, entrance criteria, and admissions guidance.

## Flexible and Online Learning

- [Online Learning Portal](https://www.abdn.ac.uk/study/online): Online degrees and short courses for flexible distance learning opportunities.

## Core University Information

- [University Homepage](https://www.abdn.ac.uk): University of Aberdeen homepage showcasing rankings, scholarships, and degree programs.
- [Study Here Portal](https://www.abdn.ac.uk/study): Main study portal offering undergraduate, postgraduate, and online degree options.
